dtm_description: 2017 product revised March 2019, photographs 2014/2015 according to official key features. This archived named product is not claimed to be the latest CSDI raster. Includes vegetation/above-ground features. EPSG2326, metres HK principal datum.
rules: Central elevation median of land cells within 25 m. Local slope from plane fit within 50 m. TPI z=(central elevation-neighbour mean)/max(neighbour SD,1m), annulus 25m to R. Land/mapped cells only. Primary R500m; TPI<=-1 valley, >1 ridge, otherwise slope<5deg plain, otherwise slope. Operational proxies, not hydrological classification.
caveats: Static historical terrain and contemporary coastline; coastline and terrain dates differ.
Coastal and small-island neighbourhoods are truncated to available land; land support reported, not replaced with sea zero.
Few stations mean landform groups and factors can be confounded; labels sensitive to scale/thresholds are retained, not removed.
Central DTM may differ from station height due to coordinates, station platform, vegetation or source differences.
